inputs.original_text: President Luis Abinader continued his high-level agenda in France this week, centering on the Dominican Republic’s integration into global standards for transparency. On 25 March 2026, Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez and OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) in Paris, formalizing a partnership to design the country’s first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy. The agreement, witnessed by President Abinader, aims to align Dominican... Click to expand... Read more
inputs.modified_text:
Folks, President Luis Abinader is over in France pushing the globalist line, cozying up to international bureaucrats instead of focusing on the home front. On 25 March 2026, Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez went ahead and signed a Memorandum of Understanding in Paris right alongside OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann, all with Abinader standing there watching. 

What are they tying themselves to? A so-called partnership to design the Dominican Republic’s very first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy, bowing down to global standards for transparency dictated by unelected foreign entities. President Abinader claims this is all about high-level integration, but traditional sovereignty and our own national institutions are being sidelined to satisfy foreign technocrats. When you let outside bodies dictate your internal governance, you chip away at the self-reliance and authority of the nation. True order and accountability come from strong, traditional leadership rooted in our own values—not from signing papers in Paris under the watchful eye of the OECD.
